about_the_game:
About the Game

Ghost Merc: Frontlines unfolds in a world gripped by geopolitical turmoil and escalating conflicts. Players assume the role of elite mercenaries, recruited by various factions to execute high-stakes missions across the globe. As tensions rise and alliances shift, players must navigate a morally ambiguous landscape where survival is paramount.

Core Gameplay Features

  • Tactical Gunplay – Engage in fast-paced FPS combat with responsive shooting mechanics, recoil control, and weapon handling.

  • Matchmaking & Server Browsing – Join matches via automated matchmaking or manually select servers for testing.

  • Game Modes – Double Tap: A high-stakes tactical mode where both teams must plant and defend bombs simultaneously. Strategic coordination and clutch plays are key to victory. More game modes coming soon.

  • Manipulate Dynamic Objects - First iteration of object manipulation for dynamic cover creation (example: you can pick up objects and place them strategically for cover creation)

  • Basic Weapon Loadouts – Test an initial selection of firearms, each with distinct stats and handling.

  • First Iteration of Sound Design – Weapons, footsteps, and ambient noise contribute to immersion, with more refinements on the way.

  • Characters / Factions Examples -

THE IRON VIPERS

The Iron Vipers are a ruthless, highly organized paramilitary group that operates like a well-oiled war machine. Composed of ex-special forces, rogue operatives, and mercenaries loyal to the highest bidder, they prioritize precision, strategy, and superior firepower. Their code is simple: win at all costs. They work under powerful corporate and military contracts, executing high-risk missions with brutal efficiency.

THE BLACK REVENANTS

The Black Revenants are an elusive and deadly insurgent force, thriving in chaos and guerrilla warfare. Made up of defectors, rebel fighters, and underground assassins, they specialize in hit-and-run tactics, sabotage, and psychological warfare. They fight not for money, but for power and vengeance, striking fear into those who stand in their way.

The characters will be fully customizable with modular armor, clothing and accessory pieces in future updates.

Early Stage Limitations & Ongoing Development

  • Work in Progress UI – Current interface elements are placeholders and will be improved over time. Below it's a wireframe representation of the future in-game home screen (not final)

  • Limited Map Selection – Dev map for testing, with more to come

  • (Future release)

  • Bugs & Stability Issues – As an early build, expect occasional crashes, desyncs, and performance inconsistencies.

  • Clan System - A dedicated clan system is in development and will be introduced in a later stage. Below it's a wireframe representation of a future clan dashboard (not final)

  • Premium Shop - Our shop will only be available at full launch. We're not trying to "milk" our player base.

WTH MOMENT


We want to extend our deepest gratitude for participating in our early stages of development. Your time, feedback and support mean the WORLD to us. Really, thank you so much!

About the team: We're a small indie dev team (100% gamers), aiming to develop a fun and competitive FPS game without useless and overwhelming mechanics like sliding while shooting and "abilities". We believe that a much simpler gameplay is the way to success, as games need to feel fun, enjoyable and not feel like another job unless you aim for that. We are currently developing the game in Unreal Engine 5, using both custom and paid customized frameworks to achieve our goals.

content_descriptors.notes:
Ghost Merc: Frontlines is a competitive first-person shooter that includes realistic combat violence, blood effects, and strong language. Players will engage in fast-paced firefights using modern weapons, with immersive audio that features occasional explicit voice lines from characters and other players.

Key mature content includes:

Frequent gunfire and combat violence

Blood effects (no dismemberment or gore)

Strong language used in character dialogue and voice lines

Online multiplayer with unmoderated voice/text communication

This game is intended for mature audiences and may not be suitable for children. Player discretion is advised.

Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 9600X / Intel Core i5-14600KF
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ASUS Radeon™ RX 7600 / Gigabyte GeForce RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The current system requirements for Ghost Merc: Frontlines are estimations based on our ongoing development process. As we move forward with playtesting and optimizations, we will provide more accurate and finalized specifications closer to launch.

short_description: A fast-paced, team-based FPS. Engage in intense firefights, coordinate with your clan, and adapt your strategy to dominate the battlefield. Featuring a competitive clan system, objective-based modes, and deep customization, every match is a test of skill and teamwork.
